## Python run

```{python}
import os
from codecarbon import OfflineEmissionsTracker

os.makedirs("py_output", exist_ok=True)
tracker = OfflineEmissionsTracker(country_iso_code="USA", output_dir="py_output")
tracker.start()

# same workload goes here

tracker.stop()
```
